findings.title: PL-09 closes the frozen executable-evidence gap
findings.detail: The successor manifest binds the worker, two transitive Python modules, JavaScript supervisor, R7 analyzer, and exact focused test source. All 11 declared byte lengths and SHA-256 identities reproduce.

findings.title: Transitive executable closure is sufficient for bounded construction review
findings.detail: The worker imports only standard-library modules plus the two bound ranking modules. The supervisor, analyzer, and tests import only platform built-ins plus bound local mechanism sources. Replay data inputs are generation inputs rather than missing executable modules.

findings.title: No scientific or authority overclaim
findings.detail: The imported candidate remains awaiting-validation, benchmark execution remains excluded, and HEN-06 passage validates construction evidence only.

criteria.basis: Frozen worker inventories the pinned tree and reads exact OIDs through bounded git cat-file --batch; substitution and CRLF regressions pass; 234 unique R7 hint hashes match raw pinned Git bytes.
Frozen supervisor owns the detached Linux process group, performs TERM/KILL escalation, and verifies absence before return; settlement regressions and all four R7 receipts agree.
R1 F1 maps to the frozen raw-object worker, regressions, and blob verification; R1 F2 maps to the frozen supervisor, settlement regressions, and four clean R7 receipts.

claim_ceiling: HEN-06 construction validation is complete. This does not scientifically validate H-EN-R2, prove delivery or model use, native quality, token savings, transfer, or untouched confirmation, authorize HEN-07 implementation, run tokenizer qualification or a benchmark, or grant provider, definition-admission, registration, release, deployment, or external-effect authority.
